name: @fhevm/host-contracts-cleartext-dev
description: HARNESS for @fhevm/host-contracts-cleartext. Never published. The payload is ./pkg.
//: Rule 9: this manifest carries every devDependency, every build/test script and all tooling config;
the published manifest in ./pkg carries none of them. `.npmignore` cannot achieve that split --
it filters files, not manifest fields.
No `workspaces` field on purpose: this package is meant to join a single global sdk workspace later,
not to be a workspace root of its own. The consequence is that npm does not install ./pkg's
dependencies, so the payload's Solidity deps are MIRRORED below as devDependencies -- forge resolves
them from this directory's node_modules via `libs` in foundry.toml. Keep the versions in lockstep
with pkg/package.json.
`prettier:check` and `prettier:write` pass `--plugin=prettier-plugin-solidity` on the CLI rather than
declaring it in .prettierrc, and .prettierrc has no comment key. Both are deliberate:
- an editor's prettier extension resolves plugin NAMES against its own module path, not this
directory's node_modules. When it cannot resolve one it fails to load the whole config and formats
with prettier's DEFAULTS (printWidth 80, not 120), so files saved in the editor came out different
from what prettier:check demands and the build failed on files that looked fine.
- .prettierrc rejects a `//` key -- unlike tsconfig.json and this file -- and warns on every run.
The cost is that the editor does not format .sol. It did not before the plugin existed either, and
prettier:write still does.
`build` ends with prepare:tarball-consumer on purpose: it starts with `clean`, which removes
test/ts/node_modules, and those tests import the package by its PUBLISHED name. Re-creating the
fixture leaves a built tree self-consistent instead of leaving test/ts unresolvable in editors.

scripts.clean: rm -rf cache out broadcast internal/.deploy-config internal/.tmp-localhost *.tsbuildinfo internal/*.tsbuildinfo test/*.tsbuildinfo pkg/ts/*.tsbuildinfo pkg/ts/_esm pkg/ts/_cjs pkg/ts/_types tarball && npm run clean:tarball-consumer
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run prettier:check && npm run lint && npm run check:zama-config && npm run check:cleartext-config && npm run build:cjs && npm run build:esm && npm run build:types && npm run test:build && npm run prepare:tarball-consumer
scripts.build:tarball: npm run build:templates && npm run build && npm run pack:tarball
scripts.build:templates: npm run generate:cleartext-config && npm run generate:contract-versions && npm run generate:compute-addresses && npm run generate:placeholders && npm run build:forge && node internal/cli/generateTemplates.ts && node internal/cli/generateSigners.ts && npm run generate:local-host-bytecode
scripts.generate:templates: node internal/cli/generateTemplates.ts && node internal/cli/generateSigners.ts && npm run generate:local-host-bytecode
scripts.test: npm run clean:tarball-consumer && npm run build:templates && npm run test:templates:run && npm run test:forge && npm run test:tarball:run
scripts.test:templates: npm run clean:tarball-consumer && npm run build:templates && npm run test:templates:run
scripts.test:tarball: npm run clean:tarball-consumer && npm run build:templates && npm run test:tarball:run
scripts.test:tarball:run: npm run build && npm run lint:tarball-consumer && vitest run --config test/ts/vitest.config.ts
